g.title: asset-conversion
g.text: Every non-XLM balance gets an explicit per-asset disposition confirmed by the user

g.title: cluster_quote
g.text: Find best available route at current market price

g.title: asset
g.text: Each balance handled independently - no silent batch-swap

g.title: soroswap_q
g.text: Routes across Soroban DEXes + classic SDEX
Covers classic tokens, Soroban tokens, and SAC-wrapped assets

g.title: sdex_q
g.text: Classic order books + AMM pools · up to 6 hops · used when Soroswap has no route

g.title: has_route
g.text: A route exists if at least one path from this asset to XLM is available

g.title: disp_preview
g.text: Per-Asset Disposition - User Confirms in Preview
Shown in accordion before any transaction is built
User makes an explicit choice for every non-XLM balance

g.title: issuer_confirm
g.text: Tool states explicitly: this is irreversible
Never labeled as a 'conversion' · right choice for spam tokens, dust, assets with no route

g.title: disp_choice
g.text: swap = default when route exists · return to issuer always requires explicit confirm

g.title: minrecv
g.text: Re-quoted at build time - if route lost, falls back to return-to-issuer

g.title: token_kind
g.text: Determines which Stellar operation to use

g.title: pp
g.text: SDEX order books + classic AMM pools · enforces minimum received on-chain

g.title: invoke
g.text: Soroban swap via Soroswap router · min_out = min_received
Soroswap API builds XDR · client decodes and verifies contract + amounts before signing

g.title: swapped
g.text: Slippage beyond tolerance causes tx to fail - user retries at new price or lowers tolerance

g.title: rm_tl
g.text: Preconditions: balance = 0 · buying_liabilities = 0 · no pool-share references
Frees 0.5 XLM base reserve (pool-share trustlines free 1.0 XLM)

g.title: issuer_pay
g.text: Sends full balance back · issuer burns it
Clears balance to zero · enables trustline removal
